controls: Explicit first-party project config and private state/home

No CLI, hooks or installer execution at startup; no new providers or resource permissions
limitations: MCP sampling can ask the host model when supported; no independent provider key is configured; ZHTW_NO_NETWORK disables Google Translate rather than host sampling

ignore_terms downgrades findings to Info but does not necessarily prevent automatic fixes; glossary.proper_nouns suppresses matching findings
Generic reference resources/prompts and CLI-only configuration/hooks are not integrated into the scoped agent
No fresh registry vulnerability scan or reproducible-build verification performed
Source build.rs installs Git hooks when compiled in a checkout; no build/install scripts were executed during integration
